cards.title: Overall favorite

cards.note: Team-win variant: Gibbs anytime TD, Lions moneyline +106 FanDuel, and LaPorta under 4.5 receptions is 35.4% (+407). The St. Brown under is the opposite side of the Lions stack.

cards.title: Game-script mix
cards.why: If Detroit leads, Gibbs should get the late carries. If Chicago trails, Williams checks down and Swift's catches go up.
cards.note: Odunze over 3.5 receptions instead of Swift is 21.4% (+326). League-wide, these two legs are close to independent.
